description: HH.AI_v2 managed secret inventory: non-secret metadata only
value_policy: No secret values, lengths, hashes, prefixes or masked fragments may appear in this file

storage_classes.CREDMAN_GENERIC: Managed by HH.AI_v2 in Windows Credential Manager as a Generic Credential with local-machine persistence, exact TargetName lookup and a UTF-16LE blob contract (D-SEC-1, D-SEC-2)
storage_classes.GH_CLI_DELEGATED: Not stored by HH.AI_v2; obtained at runtime from gh auth token after browser-based gh auth login (D-SEC-4)
storage_classes.EXTERNAL_TOOL_MANAGED: Registered only; managed by the original tool; HH.AI_v2 does not read, write or migrate it (D-SEC-3)
storage_classes.DERIVED_AT_LAUNCH: Not stored separately; derived at launch from another inventory entry
